# University of Tsukuba Neuroscience Degree Program

> Graduate neuroscience education and research at Japan's leading interdisciplinary university, offering master's and doctoral programs in brain science and behavioral neuroscience.

The Neuroscience Degree Program is part of the Graduate School of Comprehensive Human Sciences at the University of Tsukuba. It provides comprehensive graduate education in neuroscience with emphasis on both basic research and applied clinical applications, attracting international students through English-language instruction.

## Key Topics

- Neuroscience
- Graduate Education
- Brain Science
- Neuroscience Research
- Behavioral Science
- Psychiatric Disorders
